register.labelZh: START 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: start for 和 start out 可以表示啟程;start off 則可以描述活動、事件或經歷開始時的情況。；start in 可以表示某人立即着手;start on 可以指出開始處理哪項工作;start somebody off 則表示幫助另一個人開始。；start something off 可以指出甚麼事情引起一項活動或討論;start over 則表示因錯誤或問題而從頭再來。；start up 常用來描述引擎、機器或音樂開始運作;start on 和 start in on 則可能出現在攻擊、批評或反覆抱怨的情境中。
register.summaryEn: Start for and start out describe beginning a journey. Start off describes how an activity, event or experience begins. Start in can show that someone begins immediately. Start on shows which task they begin, while start somebody off shows that another person helps them. Start something off identifies what caused an event or discussion to begin. Start over shows that someone returns to the beginning after a mistake or problem. Start up is often used when engines, machines or music begin. Start on and start in on may appear in situations involving attacks, criticism or repeated complaints.
